subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity add-on — invoice recipient change, PO lines & tax forms
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan@cloudnova.com>; Alex B. <ab_procure@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Capacity add-on — invoice recipient & PO question

Hi Morgan / Alex,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation we will:
- Renew existing Dedicated capacity for one year (same model config)
- Add a 30% capacity add-on for sustained throughput starting 2028-11-01

Two billing items we need to lock down to generate the renewal invoice and PO:
1) Invoice recipient — you mentioned the operating unit is CloudNova Solutions, but finance requires invoices to go to CloudNova Holdings, Inc. Please confirm the exact payee name and billing address you want on the invoice.
2) PO specifics — to avoid routing delays can you provide a new PO that references Redwood deal RDW-78945 and splits the capacity add-on as a separate line item? If finance needs an itemized description, we can provide SKU-level language.

I have attached a signed W-9 for Redwood for your procurement team to attach to the PO. If you actually need a W-8 for an offshore parent, flag that and we can coordinate with legal.

Next steps: once I have the PO and final payee, I will push the invoice and route it to the email you specify.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: Redwood_W9_soojin_signed.pdf (W-9, pdf)
From: Morgan Lee <morgan@cloudnova.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex B. <ab_procure@cloudnova.com>; finance@cloudnova.com
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity add-on — invoice recipient & PO question

On Fri, Oct 5, 2028 at 8:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time yesterday...

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the summary — quick clarifications from finance:
1) Invoice should be issued to: CloudNova Holdings, Inc.
   Attn: Accounts Payable
   1000 Market Tower
   San Francisco, CA 94105
2) Procurement will issue PO_78945 and wants the capacity add-on as separate line (Line 2) with the start date and an estimate of monthly token volume.

Also: our parent entity is US taxable but they will require copies of both the W-9 and our vendor onboarding questionnaire (I can send that after I confirm the PO).

We will route the PO to finance@cloudnova.com. Alex, can you confirm ETA on the PO?

Best,
Morgan
Director of Cloud Ops, CloudNova
From: Alex B. (Procurement) <ab_procure@cloudnova.com>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan@cloudnova.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@cloudnova.com; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity add-on — invoice recipient & PO question

Soojin — I can confirm procurement will raise PO_78945 by EOD next Wednesday (2028-10-10). A few requests:
- Please include an explicit SKU description for the add-on: "Redwood Dedicated Capacity – 30% Add-on (RDW-78945, start 2028-11-01)".
- Can you confirm if Redwood will accept Net45 for this renewal? Our standard is Net30 but the parent has negotiated Net45 for multi-year commitments.
- Our AP team wants a consolidated invoice PDF (one file) with the PO number in the filename.

Ben — tagging you because we may need the SKU language or a shortened invoice description to include as line item text on the PO.

Thanks,
Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex B. <ab_procure@cloudnova.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Lee <morgan@cloudnova.com>; Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Oct 2028 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity add-on — invoice recipient & PO question

Alex, Morgan — thanks. Confirmations below:
- SKU language for PO: "RDW-DED-STD: Redwood Dedicated Capacity (base) – monthly metered; RDW-DED-ADD30: 30% Capacity Add-on (commit); start 2028-11-01; billed monthly."
- Payment terms: Redwood can accept Net45 for this renewal. We will set Net45 on the invoice if PO references RDW-78945.
- Invoice PDF: we will produce a single consolidated PDF and name it: Invoice_RDW-78945_CloudNovaHoldings.pdf

Irene — could you pls attach the finalized W-9 and the tax/ein confirmation to the invoice package and confirm the EIN? I attached a draft invoice to this thread for reference — please redline if anything is off.

Cheers,
Ben
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex B. <ab_procure@cloudnova.com>; Morgan Lee <morgan@cloudnova.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2028 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity add-on — invoice recipient & PO question

Alex / Morgan / Soojin,

Attached: "Redwood_W9_soojin_signed.pdf" and a stamped copy of our EIN confirmation. We confirm Redwood's EIN: 27-1234567.

Per your request we'll:
- Produce Invoice_RDW-78945_CloudNovaHoldings.pdf (single PDF, PO # on filename)
- Set payment terms Net45
- Itemize line 1 = base renewal; line 2 = RDW-DED-ADD30 (30% add-on) with monthly estimated token volume noted in the line description

Please reply if you need the invoice emailed to a different address than finance@cloudnova.com. Once Alex confirms PO_78945 is issued, we'll finalize and send the invoice for PR/PO matching.

Regards,
Irene Choi
